data.name: Intrigue Romance
data.detailed_description:
ASTERHAVEN: A Living, Breathing Open World

 In Asterhaven, every NPC lives a complete life—just like you. Driven by advanced AI, they form a complex web of social relationships that evolves independently of your actions. Navigate through 1,500+ NPCs spanning diverse ethnicities, personalities, and social classes. Attend galas, climb corporate ladders, fall in love, marry, purchase property, raise children, trade stocks, launch businesses, and uncover secrets that could topple dynasties. Every choice sends ripples through this living society, triggering butterfly effects that send both you and the NPCs down radically different paths.

 

Three Crises. One Nation. Story Depends on Your Move.

- Ethnic strife tearing the Commonwealth apart

- Financial warfare threatening economic collapse  

- Espionage networks infiltrating from within

 

Features

- An epic, branching main storyline with multiple endings

- Procedurally generated side quests that adapt to your choices

- 200+ dynamic events weaving a true emergent narrative

Background Story: The Birth of a Nation

  Decades ago, exiled peoples from across the world founded the Commonwealth of Asterhaven. Through grueling wars against the Kingdom of Ardore, this fledgling nation transformed into a global maritime powerhouse. But prosperity bred resentment, and old ethnic wounds began to fester...

  The Kingdom of Ardore saw its opening. Through financial manipulation and covert operations, the Ardorian Queen set hidden currents swirling through Asterhaven. Crises mount. The Commonwealth teeters.

  Your time has come. Will you wield power to crush these threats? Bridge the ethnic divide through understanding? Or stand apart and watch the storm consume everything? The vortex of politicians and oligarchs awaits your choice.

 

1,500+ Living Souls. One Interconnected Society.

- 1,500+ NPCs with distinct personalities and worldviews

- Each NPC possesses unique traits, relationships, and ambitions

- Complete social lives equal to your own

 

Every NPC evolves alongside Asterhaven's society—forming friendships, pursuing romances, building careers, accumulating wealth. They may be strangers, colleagues, rivals, nemeses, friends, lovers... even spouses and co-parents.

Driven by individual AI systems, countless NPCs form a vast social network, influencing one another in ways that make every playthrough genuinely unpredictable.

  

20,000+ Portraits. 3 Million Words. Never the Same Conversation Twice.

- 20,000+ portrait variations showing how NPCs change over time

- Dynamic dialogue based on social status, relationship depth, and personality

- 3 million words of text ensuring characters rarely repeat themselves

 

5 Skill Branches | 12 Industries | 62 Careers. Master the Real Working World.

  Get hired. Get promoted. Jump ship.

  Master industry-specific skills, choose your field, earn the trust of superiors and loyalty of colleagues, and build lasting client and vendor relationships.

  Socialize. Romance. Build a Life. Navigate Love and Betrayal.

 

- Galas & Gatherings – Maximize your networking efficiency

- Gifts & Favors – Exchange randomized stat-boosting items with real investment value

- Patronage – Help others climb, or accept help yourself

- Introductions – Meet exactly who you need to know

- Dating & Marriage – Seize your Crush before they slip away

- Renting & Buying – Invest in real estate or simply find your home

- Loans, Stocks & Investments – Diversify your income streams

- Blackmail & Bribery – Secrets come from unspeakable acts. Information is power.

 

Build Your Empire Through Connections by Any Means Necessary,

 - Found your company – Expand client relationships, construct your supplier network

- Sales & Procurement – Win contracts, profit between demand and supply

- Tongue-Tied – A card-based persuasion game for high-stakes negotiations

- The Conference – Battle for support in complex corporate politics

- Financing & Leverage – Use debt to amplify your gains

- Investment & Acquisition – Become a titan of Asterhaven commerce

 

Welcome to the Commonwealth. Your story in Asterhaven begins now.

Interact with 1,500+ rNPCs of diverse classes, ethnicities and personalities, forming a vast social network and branching storylines.Every decision triggers a butterfly effect, altering the world’s trajectory.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS *: Windows 7 / Windows 8 / Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 2.50GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: HD4400
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920×1080 或 2560×1440 屏幕分辨率

  • Processor: 3.20GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920×1080 or 2560×1440 pixels

data.legal_notice: This game features hundreds of scenes and nearly 2,000 NPCs, created with the assistance of AI. The facial features of the NPCs are sourced from authorized real-life models and generated via modeling software; no unauthorized real-person materials are used in the production process. Given the large number of character images, any unintended resemblance to real persons is purely coincidental.

content_descriptors.notes:
Content Warning

This game contains:

- Suggestive attire – Some female characters wear revealing or provocative outfits
- Mild verbal aggression – Simulated hostile language in certain scenarios
- Fictional political themes – Alternate-world political elements including ethnic conflict, espionage, and ideological struggle
- Organized crime depictions – Portrayals of underground criminal networks and gang activities

Recommended for mature audiences. Not suitable for minors.
